description: REQ-001/002/013/015 require the production success artifact to be the closed, same-run nine-dependency schema. The production CLI instead serializes buildPreflightReport's legacy schemaVersion/kind/overallStatus report directly and never invokes validateAndBuildFinalReport, so a controlled success cannot produce the specified final artifact or its runRef, checkedAt correlation, and effects fields.

evidence.snippet: const report = await buildPreflightReport({ checks, controlledL3, timeoutMs: args.timeoutMs }); ... fs.writeFileSync(handle, `${JSON.stringify(report, null, 2)}\n`);
